quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Enters India, Expanding AI Cloud Platform With (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave announced its entry into India: through a collaboration with AdaniConneX it plans to expand its AI Cloud platform with 240 megawatts (MW) of data center capacity in Navi Mumbai. The campus will span three 80 MW buildings at AdaniConneX's Taloja campus, with CoreWeave as the sole tenant across the three buildings and the opportunity to double capacity by expanding by up to 240 MW at the campus. CoreWeave plans to deploy the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform there; the Taloja facilities are being designed for high-density AI infrastructure, including direct liquid cooling for GPU data halls and a non-evaporative chilled water system. The first phase is expected to be available in mid-2028, with additional capacity coming online in phases. CoreWeave also intends to establish an office in India and hire locally. COO Sachin Jain: 'We are investing in the infrastructure, technology, and local presence needed to support that growth, bringing 240 megawatts of capacity, NVIDIA Vera Rubin, and CoreWeave's expertise to customers building and scaling AI in India.' The release says the expansion reflects growing customer demand for CoreWeave's AI Cloud and follows its recent entry into Indonesia.
quarterly_data.figure: 240 MW planned in Navi Mumbai (three 80 MW buildings); option to expand by up to 240 MW; first phase expected mid-2028
